scope: Read-only REA audit, PNG/PDF runtime verification pending

png.metadata: MIME image/png, category image, extension png, actual size
png.flow: Internal content_url -> content_redirect with headers -> host httpFetch bytes -> local blob/image URL

pdf.metadata: MIME application/pdf, category pdf, extension pdf, actual size
pdf.flow: Host bytes -> Uint8Array -> local data URL -> bundled PDF.js getDocument({data,worker})

thumbnails.limitation: PNG can reuse image content; PDF bytes cannot serve as an image thumbnail

limits: Current helper category defaults to document for non-images; pdf category needs mapping before filtered browse tests
